petitioner.
 Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional 
Chief Standing Counsel for the State. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
would submit that due to cadre change 
of the respondent no.6, the seniority of 
the petitioner is affected. 
 Learned State Counsel would submit 
that there is no two cadres in view of 
the principle which has been settled by 
this Court in its judgment dated 
13.06.2024, passed in WPSS No.976 of 
2024, Geeta Gururani and others vs. 
State of Uttarakhand and others. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner 
seeks time to argue the matter.
